CFB-week.summary: Three midweek games: Memphis at USF and Louisiana at ULM on Thursday night, Florida State at Pitt on Friday. Pitt has started Holden Geriner at quarterback since Mason Heintschel tore his ACL at Virginia Tech on Oct. 2, so the packet's Pitt QB averages are stale. No current-week injury reports were found for the Thursday games before kickoff; Florida State and Pitt availability reports were not yet posted in search results.

NBA-DET-at-WSH-1113.summary: Second meeting this week after Monday's game in Detroit. Detroit stays without Jalen Duren (hamstring, re-evaluation about two weeks out) and Isaiah Joe (hip), so John Collins keeps starting at center. Washington is missing Vukcevic, Beekman, Champagnie and Jamir Watkins. Detroit is a 10.5-point road favorite with a 220.5 total, so a lopsided game could cut starters' fourth-quarter minutes.

NFL-WAS-at-NYG-1113.summary: Final reports confirm Cam Skattebo (hamstring) and J.J. McCarthy (hip) have no game designations after full practices, so Skattebo returns as the Giants' lead back and Singletary moves back to a reserve role; LB Malik Harrison is the only Giant listed (questionable), and CB Colton Hood (finger) finished full. Washington is out G/C Lucas Patrick and TE Colson Yankoff, with Daniels full all week, Burks expected to play, and McLaurin still on IR (Croskey-Merritt's IR status was not re-checked today). The total has slid from 42.5 to 40.5 with rain and gusty wind forecast.

SOCCER-day.summary: All 14 listed players are in their national squads for this window, and no injury or suspension was found for any of them. None has a confirmed lineup yet. Absences elsewhere: Spain without Rodri and Olmo, Germany without Musiala and Gnabry, England without Saka and Mainoo.

NBA-BOS-at-TOR-1112.summary: Toronto is shorthanded: Scottie Barnes (groin) is out, Kawhi Leonard (knee) and Nate Bittle (foot) remain out, and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Collin Murray-Boyles (illness) are questionable. Boston has no listed injuries and is about a 7-point road favorite with a total near 216. Ball-handling and usage shift toward Barrett, Walter and Shead.

NBA-SA-at-CHI-1112.summary: Spurs are without Tobias Harris (calf) and Devin Vassell (groin) is questionable after missing Monday. Chicago's Norman Powell is questionable with back spasms after sitting out Nov 8 with a shoulder issue; Zach Collins (illness) and Tobe Awaka (back) are also questionable. Buzelis is healthy but his rebounds line fell a full point from open without a clear reason.

NBA-WSH-at-IND-1112.summary: Indiana is still without Haliburton (hamstring), Sheppard (knee surgery) and Furphy. McConnell, the stand-in starting point guard, is questionable Wednesday with a strained hamstring, so Nembhard could see more ball-handling if he sits. Oubre has just come back from a calf issue. Washington is missing Vukcevic, Champagnie and Beekman, all depth pieces.
